circuits.name: lock_compliance_policy
circuits.summary: Locks a private auditor compliance corridor [min_band, max_band] + policy_salt on-chain via domain-separated persistentHash without disclosing the bounds.

circuits.name: submit_sealed_bid
circuits.summary: Proves 0 < amount <= reserve_cap in ZK, enforces pk != issuer_pk and single-bid-per-identity, stores local receipt, and discloses only bidder pk + salted bid commitment.

circuits.name: close_bidding
circuits.summary: Authenticates issuer via private sk, requires at least one sealed bid, and transitions ledger phase from open to revealing.

circuits.name: reveal_bid
circuits.summary: Verifies persistentHash(tid, pk, amount, salt) matches the bidder's committed slot, blocks replay, and deterministically tracks the lowest valid winning_bid.

circuits.name: finalize_award
circuits.summary: Authenticates issuer and requires at least one revealed bid (has_winner == true) before locking phase = awarded.

circuits.name: prove_compliance_band
circuits.summary: Proves winning_bid lies within private [min_band, max_band] and (when policy_locked) matches on-chain policy_commitment using private policy_salt — disclosing only compliance_hash.

circuits.name: settle_tender
circuits.summary: Authenticates issuer and enforces compliance_ok == true before marking phase = settled.

circuits.name: cancel_tender
circuits.summary: Allows issuer emergency cancellation strictly while phase is open or revealing (blocked post-award and post-settlement).

witnesses.name: local_secret_key
witnesses.description: 32-byte actor secret key (never disclosed; only derive_pk(sk) leaves witness)

witnesses.name: get_bid_amount
witnesses.description: Private Uint<64> sealed bid quote (range-proved in ZK, hidden during open phase)

witnesses.name: get_bid_salt
witnesses.description: 32-byte bidder blinding salt (never disclosed on-chain in any phase)

witnesses.name: get_audit_band
witnesses.description: Private [min_band, max_band] compliance corridor (never disclosed on-chain)

witnesses.name: get_policy_salt
witnesses.description: 32-byte auditor policy blinding salt (never disclosed on-chain)

witnesses.name: store_bid_receipt
witnesses.description: Persists committed (amount, salt) strictly into local device private state

ledgerFields.name: phase
ledgerFields.type: Enum TenderPhase (open | revealing | awarded | settled | cancelled)
